description: This Java source file defines the NoteShareActivity class, which manages the sharing functionality for notes within the Nextcloud Notes Android client. It handles user interactions for sharing notes via links, contacts, and permissions, manages share entities, and integrates with various UI components and repositories.

classes.name: NoteShareActivity
classes.description: An activity managing note sharing functionalities, including creating links, sharing via contacts, managing permissions, and displaying share information.
